productConcept.name: Foliant
productConcept.description: A rare building materials archive and specification platform for heritage restoration projects, providing provenance-grade documentation for conservation architects and restoration specialists.
productConcept.rationale: The warm ivory palette (#f6f1ed), forest-green structural color (#183f26), and Cormorant Garamond heading typeface signal archival materiality and institutional authority — aesthetics that map precisely to the conservation architecture world, where provenance documentation is the core product and material quality is judged by evidence rather than appearance. The gold accent (#e8b14d) reads as a currency of authenticity. The system's 'percussive-precise' motion character matches the deliberate, unhurried pace of conservation practice.

animationDecision: motion-tokens: non-trivial durations (0.65s grand, 0.91s structural), named expo-out easing curves, scroll video references in concept_by_video.md
animationsImplemented: 1. Character scatter via Splitting.js — hero title, stagger: 0.03s, duration: 0.65s, ease: 'back.out'
2. SVG path draw — decorative rule in intro section, strokeDashoffset scrub
3. Number counters — 4 stat items, gsap.from({val:0} pattern, 2s, power2.out
4. Multi-layer parallax — hero video y:20%, ambient video y:-15%
5. Clip-path iris bloom — materials image ellipse(0→150%), footer from bottom
6. Scattered assembly — process steps, random x/y/rotation from viewport thirds
7. Magnetic/elastic hover — CTA primary button, mousemove + elastic.out reset
organicDividers: process-to-ambient: CSS skewY diagonal clip-path bridge
assetGenerationStatus: ⛔ skipped — asset generation explicitly disabled per user instructions (do not run Steps 7-8)

assetsReferenced.materials.html: catalog card images per material entry
